_comment: Phase 14.E: Azure Storage ARM (resource-manager) spec — Microsoft.Storage/storageAccounts. Drives the new `azure_arm_storageaccounts` frontend that accepts ARM control-plane calls (azurerm Terraform provider, az storage account CLI, Azure SDK) and acknowledges them statelessly — the shim is account-agnostic, so accounts are routing-fiction; subsequent data-plane operations target the existing azure_blob frontend.
